exact_original_statement: For a connected, locally finite almost transitive graph G with positive Cheeger constant, p_c(G) < p_u(G) (Benjamini and Schramm 1996, Conjecture 6). The original article defines site percolation and says its nonplanar questions also apply, with minor modifications, to bond percolation.

original_primary_source.locators: pp. 72-73 definitions; p. 76 Conjecture 6; PDF lines 50-89 and 255-260

assigned_cayley_form: For every finite generating set of every infinite finitely generated nonamenable group, the associated Cayley graph has p_c<p_u for Bernoulli bond percolation. The amenable direction is known.
